import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def f(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; n=len(g)
    zero={(r,c) for r in range(n) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]==0}
    def orth(p): return [(p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc) for dr,dc in[(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)] if 0<=p[0]+dr<n and 0<=p[1]+dc<len(g[0])]
    changed=set()
    st=list(zero)
    # flood from zero-cells having exactly one zero-orth-neighbor
    while st:
        q=st.pop()
        if q in changed: continue
        changed.add(q)
        for a,b in orth(q):
            if (a,b) in zero and (a,b) not in changed: st.append((a,b))
    for r,c in changed: g[r][c]=8
    return g
ok = f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output']
print('match:', ok)
